## Abstract

The guiding question of this session is: why is the (German) **heat transition** much more
than a mere replacement of technologies or simple technological change? To illuminate this
question, we introduce a **systems perspective** on technologies and technological change,
which also takes into account actors, material artifacts, and rules and institutions. The
approach is not specific to the German heat transition, and you can apply it to other cases
as well.
